name: Packages Ai
summary: This module contains the AI streaming runtime for the pi repository: provider adapters for a dozen AI APIs (Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Completions/Responses/Codex, Google Generative AI/Vertex, Bedrock, Mistral, etc.), the models registry, auth flows (API key and OAuth device/browser flows), message type definitions, and a large scripted model data generation toolchain. The core is the `Models` class tying providers, credentials, model catalogs, and streaming together, with per-provider `stream`/`streamSimple` adapters that translate the unified transcript/event model to each wire protocol. Also includes utilities for SSE parsing, JSON repair, retries, context overflow detection, and token estimation.
keyPoints: Unified streaming interface: every provider (e.g., anthropic-messages, openai-completions, bedrock-converse-stream) exports a `stream` and `streamSimple` function returning an `AssistantMessageEventStream` that emits a normalized event sequence, while provider-specific options types (AnthropicOptions, BedrockOptions, etc.) extend StreamOptions in src/api/types and in each adapter's file.

The `Models` class (src/models.ts) is the public façade: it registers providers, refreshes model catalogs with network fetches and manifest-based validation (scripts/model-data.ts), resolves auth credentials, and applies per-request transforms such as header injection and prompt-cache session keys.

Auth is split into API-key resolution (src/auth/resolve.ts, src/env-api-keys.ts) and OAuth flows per provider (src/auth/oauth/*, e.g., anthropic.ts, github-copilot.ts, openai-codex.ts); OAuth flows support local callback servers, device code polling, token refresh, and lazy module loading through src/auth/oauth/load.ts.

Model data is generated by scripts/generate-models.ts and generate-image-models.ts, which fetch provider catalogs (OpenRouter, Together, NVIDIA, etc.) at build time; src/scripts/model-data.ts validates the generated directory against a manifest with exact model-id assertions and a JSON structure hash.

Event processing utilities live in src/utils/: assistant-message-frame.ts converts raw provider events into a compact frame format (with tool-call catch-up), json-parse.ts repairs malformed streamed JSON, event-stream.ts implements the FIFO queue behind AssistantMessageEventStream, and overflow.ts/retry.ts classify error messages to detect context overflow, retryable failures, and rate limits.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for the Anthropic Messages SSE API: builds params, handles OAuth and header merging, decodes SSE events into text/thinking/toolcall deltas, and computes usage. Also manages beta features like fine-grained tool streaming.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for OpenAI-compatible chat completions (used by openrouter, together, etc.). Handles reasoning fields (reasoning_content, reasoning_details), tool call streaming with grammar-constrained input properties, and provider compat flags like cache control format.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for AWS Bedrock ConverseStream using the SDK client. Resolves region/credentials from ARN, env, or explicit options, supports bearer-token auth, custom headers via middleware, and stream events for text/thinking/tool calls with redacted reasoning.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for the OpenAI Responses API, on top of the shared processResponsesStream in openai-responses-shared.ts. Handles reasoning items, tool calls, and service-tier based pricing.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for OpenAI Codex with a WebSocket-first transport that falls back to SSE. Compresses request bodies with zstd, manages websocket session cache/fallback, and handles rate-limit retry logic.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for Mistral's chat API, supporting SSE streaming, tool calls, prompt caching, and reasoning effort/prompt-mode options.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for Google's Generative AI (Gemini) SDK, streaming content parts into thinking/text blocks with thought signatures, and reasoning levels or token budgets.

entryPoints.name: stream
entryPoints.note: Adapter for Google Vertex AI, sharing conversion helpers with google-generative-ai via google-shared.ts. Supports API-key or ADC-based auth and custom base URLs.

entryPoints.name: createModels
entryPoints.note: (via Models interface) Factory for a Models instance that wires up providers, credential store, auth context, and refresh generation tracking. But entry point not directly exported; see createModels in src/models.ts.

entryPoints.name: createImagesModels
entryPoints.note: Factory for the image-generation equivalent of Models, wrapping images providers (currently openrouter-images) with auth resolution and generateImages dispatch.

entryPoints.name: registerBuiltInApiProviders
entryPoints.note: Registers the built-in API streaming adapters into the registry (with lazy loading wrappers). Also exports stream/complete/streamSimple/completeSimple functions for resolving a model's api to its adapter.

entryPoints.name: builtinProviders
entryPoints.note: Constructs the list of built-in provider instances (each with auth config, model lists, and streaming entry points), used by compat and model store.

entryPoints.name: registerBundledOAuthFlowLoaders
entryPoints.note: Allows bundlers to substitute OAuth module loaders (e.g., in Bun) so only the requested provider's OAuth code is pulled in at runtime.
